dedupe_keys.name: dataset for the publication theory and experimental validation of two techniques for compensating vt nonlinearities

description: D'Avanzo Giovanni and colleagues publish this resource through the source community. Two deposits by the same eight-author team describe measurements supporting IEEE paper 10.1109/TIM.2022.3147883 on two techniques for compensating voltage-transformer nonlinearities. Both list Data_set_sindi.xlsx; the companion explicitly labels its data as VT_B. Coverage is the study data family. The file sizes differ, so byte identity, revisions and component overlap remain unresolved. They are grouped to avoid counting a second independent measurement collection from a near-matching deposit. No workbook values or formulas were read. Zenodo supplies the deposited data and native file inventory with open access under cc-by-4.0. Sample values, linked files and code were not read or executed during source checks. A limitation is that complete implementation or measurement settings cannot be reconstructed from descriptive metadata alone. Related experimental components and publications retain their distinct roles; separate deposits are not assumed to provide independent observations. The spreadsheets support experimental evaluation of transformer nonlinearity compensation.
